verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for any product with public docs, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence Ghostty offers it: probes show https://ghostty.org/llms.txt and https://ghostty.org/docs.md both return HTTP 404. The `ghostty +show-config --default --docs` CLI output is ordinary human-oriented config documentation, an adjacent feature rather than agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
